mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction ( tx_group_id, user_id, currency_type, tx_type, amount, balance_after, service_id, unit_price, quantity, lot_seq, lot_expire_date, ref_tx_seq, comment ) VALUES ( #{txGroupId}, #{userId}, #{currencyType}, #{txType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{serviceId}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{lotSeq}, #{lotExpireDate}, #{refTxSeq}, #{comment} )
mapper.select: SELECT seq, tx_group_id AS txGroupId, user_id AS userId, currency_type AS currencyType, tx_type AS txType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, service_id AS serviceId, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity, lot_seq AS lotSeq, lot_expire_date AS lotExpireDate, ref_tx_seq AS refTxSeq, comment, reg_date AS regDate FROM transaction WHERE seq = #{seq}

SELECT seq, tx_group_id AS txGroupId, user_id AS userId, currency_type AS currencyType, tx_type AS txType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, service_id AS serviceId, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity, lot_seq AS lotSeq, lot_expire_date AS lotExpireDate, ref_tx_seq AS refTxSeq, comment, reg_date AS regDate FROM transaction WHERE tx_group_id = #{txGroupId} ORDER BY seq ASC

SELECT seq, tx_group_id AS txGroupId, user_id AS userId, currency_type AS currencyType, tx_type AS txType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, service_id AS serviceId, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity, lot_seq AS lotSeq, lot_expire_date AS lotExpireDate, ref_tx_seq AS refTxSeq, comment, reg_date AS regDate FROM transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT seq, tx_group_id AS txGroupId, user_id AS userId, currency_type AS currencyType, tx_type AS txType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, service_id AS serviceId, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity, comment, reg_date AS regDate FROM transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY seq DESC

SELECT seq, tx_group_id AS txGroupId, user_id AS userId, currency_type AS currencyType, tx_type AS txType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, service_id AS serviceId, comment, reg_date AS regDate FROM transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tx_type = #{txType} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT seq, tx_group_id AS txGroupId, user_id AS userId, currency_type AS currencyType, tx_type AS txType, amount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, service_id AS serviceId, unit_price AS unitPrice, quantity, lot_seq AS lotSeq, lot_expire_date AS lotExpireDate, comment, reg_date AS regDate FROM transaction WHERE lot_seq = #{lotSeq} ORDER BY seq ASC
